title: Portugal
dek: A nine-day guided loop from Lisbon with Portugal Motorcycle Tours: up the Atlantic coast to Porto, north to the Minho and Peneda-Gerês, through the Douro Valley, south on the N2, and home across the Alentejo by Marvão and Évora.

days.label: Stage 1
days.title: Lisbon up the Atlantic coast
prose: Out of Lisbon by Sintra and onto the back roads of the west coast: fishing and surfing villages, fruit orchards, and the Atlantic road with the ocean alongside most of the way north.

days.label: Stage 2
days.title: Porto
prose: A short coastal run into Porto, then a day off the bike for a food tour through the city’s small eateries and tascas.

days.label: Stage 3
days.title: The Minho and Peneda-Gerês
prose: North through the green-wine country of the Minho to Monção on the Spanish border, then into Peneda-Gerês, Portugal’s only national park: granite ridges, oak and pine forest, stone villages and mountain lagoons.

days.label: Stage 4
days.title: The Douro Valley
prose: East into the Douro, the world’s oldest demarcated wine region, following the river through terraced vineyards to Pinhão. One of the best riding days of the trip.

days.label: Stage 5
days.title: South on the N2
prose: South through Viseu on the N2, Portugal’s longest road and its answer to Route 66, through the hill country of the interior.

days.label: Stage 6
days.title: The Alentejo and back to Lisbon
prose: Down to the hilltop fortress of Marvão on the Spanish border, across the cork-oak plains of the Alentejo to Évora, and back to Lisbon to close the loop.

callout.name: Portugal Motorcycle Tours — North Tour
callout.text: This loop was the guided North Tour from Lisbon: the Atlantic coast, a food tour in Porto, the Douro Valley, Trás-os-Montes, Peneda-Gerês and the N2 back south. Highly recommended if you want to ride Portugal with people who know every back road.
